binaries.pinRule: Filled only from reviewed build bytes; envelope enforces launcher/probe pins via compiled EXPECT_* and deny-write handles held for the whole phase.

testDomain.nonce: 32 lowercase hex, fresh CSPRNG per invocation, not all zero, never reused
testDomain.noJournalGenesis: No journal file is created by any phase; EXLOCK remains a later separate test.
testDomain.cleanup: Creator only, after every recorded identity is signalled; exact whitelisted names, nonrecursive. Envelope and observer never clean up.

arguments.lexical: Program token then at most 16 tokens matching [0-9a-z]{1,32}; total command line <= 1024 UTF-16 units; anything else ArgumentsRefused. No JSON, Boolean, path, or resource value is accepted from arguments.
arguments.retry: none; a refusal or unknown outcome ends the invocation and requires a new reviewed admission

steps: Creator is itself an existing independently constrained, separately reviewed fixed program; its own footprint and lifetime are outside this envelope and must be accounted in its own review.
CreateJobObjectW(NULL, NULL) for Job E; handle non-inheritable and never duplicated to any process.

SetInformationJobObject(E, JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation): LimitFlags exactly KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE|JOB_MEMORY|ACTIVE_PROCESS|AFFINITY|DIE_ON_UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION|JOB_TIME (0x2000|0x200|0x8|0x10|0x400|0x4 = 0x261C); JobMemoryLimit 402653184 (384 MiB); ActiveProcessLimit 7; Affinity 1; PerJobUserTimeLimit 300000000.

Duplicate own process handle (SYNCHRONIZE|PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION) inheritable; PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_HANDLE_LIST exactly {stdin, stdout, stderr pipes with finite reader budgets, that creator handle}.
CreateProcessW(envelope path, fixed argument vector, bInheritHandles TRUE, CREATE_SUSPENDED|CREATE_NO_WINDOW|EXTENDED_STARTUPINFO_PRESENT, cwd = test directory).
AssignProcessToJobObject(E, envelope) while suspended; verify IsProcessInJob and E accounting active=1,total=1; only then ResumeThread. On any failure TerminateProcess(envelope) before resume.
Own a wall deadline of 60000 ms: TerminateJobObject(E) at deadline (also kills nested T and O); read stdout up to 16384 bytes total, refuse more; retain everything on timeout.
Never retry; record envelope PID+creation, exit code, bytes read, E accounting at end.
creatorContract.envelopeVerifiesAtEntry: Immediate Job flags/caps/CPU exact, active=1 and total=1, creator handle PID+creation exact and alive, creator created earlier. Unverifiable by envelope: that no other handle to E exists and that the creator enforces its wall deadline; these remain creator-review obligations.

requiredFields: liveFloorMiB (validated live guestd floor, >=18432 or higher)

physicalMiB = full P upper bound of not-yet-reflected reservations: manager starting/uncertain rows in full, router durable pending head, already-admitted-not-started work, other host work; safe double counting until exact epoch/id dedup
heldMiB >= 384 test budget honoured by every manager and direct admission path
capacityHoldInterface.notRequired: Router waiting pre-admission queue length; no global drain.
capacityHoldInterface.currentBehaviour: capacity_hold() returns CapacityInterfaceAbsent before any child creation.

admissionRule.physical: freshAvailPhysMiB >= max(18432, liveFloorMiB) + P + 384 where 384 = candidate 256 + observer O 64 + envelope early/steady remainder E 64, all hard job-commit caps nested in Job E
admissionRule.duringRun: best-effort 50 ms sample: avail < floor + P or hold expiry -> TerminateJobObject(T); not a hard global floor guarantee
admissionRule.residualNotEnforced: Kernel pool, page tables and shared image pages are not job-commit charged; must be bounded by the hold review or remain an open gap.

limits.jobT: flags 0x261C minus JOB_TIME = 0x2618, 256 MiB, 4 processes, affinity 1, no breakaway, kill-on-close held only by envelope
limits.receipt: probe JSON (unchanged semantics) then envelope receipt

death.jobO: flags 0x261C minus KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE = 0x061C, 64 MiB, 1 process, affinity 1, CPU 5 s
death.wrapper: envelope process = sole Job T owner
death.observerAction: TerminateProcess(exact wrapper handle, 0x4F000000|nonce low 24 bits) then wait exact 3 descendant handles 5000 ms
death.receipt: observer JSON; envelope JSON only if it survives (ObserverDied/DeathNotObserved/other)

observer: outcome in {ownerDeathObservedUnqualified, wrapperExitedOtherwise, descendantExitedBeforeAction, notAliveBeforeAction, unknown}

refusals.launcherOwnExit96: launcher not inside exact preconfigured Job T at entry
